definitions.explanation: In a manner that shows skill and efficiency, getting things done smoothly without wasted effort.

examples.japanese: {手際|てぎわ}よく{料理|りょうり}を{作|つく}った。
{手際|てぎわ}よく{荷物|にもつ}をまとめた。
ベテランのシェフが{手際|てぎわ}よく{食材|しょくざい}を{切|き}り{分|わ}けていく{様子|ようす}に{見入|みい}った。
examples.english: I was captivated watching the experienced chef deftly cut and portion the ingredients.

notes:
The adverbial form of {手際|てぎわ}がいい (to be skillful/efficient). {手際|てぎわ} literally means "hand skill" or "dexterity" — the よく form turns it into an adverb meaning "in a skilled manner." Implies practiced, smooth execution without hesitation or wasted motion.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {手際|てぎわ}よく{片付|かたづ}ける: to tidy up efficiently
- {手際|てぎわ}よくこなす: to handle skillfully
- {手際|てぎわ}よく{進|すす}める: to proceed efficiently
- {手際|てぎわ}よく{処理|しょり}する: to handle/process deftly

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {上手|じょうず}に: skillfully — more general, less emphasis on efficiency
- {要領|ようりょう}よく: efficiently — emphasizes getting to the point, knowing the tricks
- {器用|きよう}に: dexterously — focuses on manual skill
- {手早|てばや}く: quickly and efficiently — emphasizes speed
